questions.question: What is the industry standard requirement for High Availability (HA) in critical financial infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Five nines (99.999%) is the gold standard for critical infrastructure, allowing only about 5 minutes of downtime per year.

questions.question: Which security standard is mandatory for processing credit card transactions?
questions.explanation: PCI-DSS is the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard.

tabs.label: 🇺🇸 US Operations
tabs.content: Fully compliant with CCPA. Core data centers audited and achieved SOC 2 Type II Certification for security, availability, and processing integrity.

tabs.label: 🇪🇺 EU Operations
tabs.content: Strict adherence to GDPR data privacy frameworks. Localized data sharding ensures European customer data never leaves the EU zones.

tabs.label: 🌏 APAC Expansion
tabs.content: Acquired Major Payment Institution licenses in Singapore (MAS) and Hong Kong (HKMA) to process cross-border B2B transactions.
